sources.excerpt: March 9, 2022 - Claims that COVID-19 vaccines “permanently alter your DNA” were resurrected recently

reasoning: mRNA COVID-19 vaccines (such as those developed by Pfizer-BioNTech and Moderna) do not enter the cell nucleus where human DNA is housed, nor do they contain the necessary enzymes (such as reverse transcriptase) to convert RNA into DNA or integrate into the human genome. According to major scientific institutions, health authorities (including the CDC, WHO, and Mayo Clinic), and peer-reviewed molecular biology research, mRNA vaccines deliver temporary instructions to the cell's cytoplasm to produce the coronavirus spike protein. Once the protein is produced, the cell rapidly degrades the mRNA. Claims that these vaccines permanently alter human DNA are scientifically unfounded and have been repeatedly debunked.
title: mRNA vaccines alter human DNA
